title_zh: 看到华为三星折叠机受关注后，库克推动苹果加速研发折叠屏 iPhone
content_zh:
据彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果研发折叠屏 iPhone 的历程已历时近十年，该设备售价预计将超过 2000 美元，标志着苹果近 20 年来最大的设计变革。

报道披露，苹果对折叠设备的关注可追溯至 2020 年前后。彼时苹果 CEO Tim Cook 在结束一次亚洲之行后，对折叠屏手机这一新兴品类表现出了异乎寻常的积极态度。

在走访中国等亚洲地区的行程中，Tim Cook 观察到越来越多消费者开始使用来自三星电子、华为等手机厂商的折叠屏设备。这次见闻让他确信苹果必须推出自家的折叠产品，并随即推动公司加速在这一新兴市场的研发步伐。
title_en: Tim Cook Accelerates Foldable iPhone Development After Seeing Samsung and Huawei's Success in Asia
content_en:
Apple has been developing a foldable iPhone for nearly a decade, with the highly anticipated device expected to retail for over $2,000, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. This project represents Apple's most significant design overhaul in nearly 20 years.

The tech giant's focus on foldable technology intensified around 2020. Following a trip to Asia, Apple CEO Tim Cook observed the growing popularity of foldable devices from competitors like Samsung and Huawei.

Convinced that Apple needed its own entry in this emerging category, Cook reportedly pushed the company to accelerate its research and development efforts to capture a share of the foldable market.

title_zh: OpenAI 发布 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题候选解，等待数学界检验
content_zh:
OpenAI 9 月 8 日公布一份 Navier–Stokes 存在性与光滑性问题的候选解，同时发布了数学论文和 Lean 形式化证明。公司称，这份证明给出了光滑三维不可压缩流体在有限时间内形成奇点的构造，对应克莱数学研究所问题表述中的 C 和 D 类情形。

OpenAI 称，证明由一个能力高于 GPT-6 Astra 的内部模型完成，系统一度协调约 1 万个并发 Agent。从启动到得到候选解用时约 88 小时，随后由 GPT-6 Astra 花费 17 小时完成 Lean 形式化和验证；Navier–Stokes 项目共产生约 270 万条代理消息和 1300 亿个输出 token。

这项工作也牵出了同期的 Euler 方程研究争议。纽约大学数学教授 Tristan Buckmaster 质疑 OpenAI 是否利用了他与 Anthropic 研究人员 Levent Alpöge 在 Codex 中的项目数据。OpenAI 称求解过程没有访问具体用户数据，但不能完全排除去标识化使用数据曾参与模型改进；双方公开的证明所针对的问题也并不相同。

这份候选解尚未经过全球数学界的独立检验。按克莱数学研究所规则，一项解答需先在合格出版物发表，至少经过两年严格审查并获得广泛认可，才会进入奖项考虑程序。OpenAI 称无意为该结果申请奖项。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，OpenAI 宣布攻克千禧年难题，清华姚班传奇陈立杰：不可思议的时代
title_en: OpenAI Proposes Candidate Solution to Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
content_en:
On September 8, OpenAI announced a candidate solution to the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, releasing both a mathematical paper and a formalized proof in the Lean programming language. The proof constructs a finite-time singularity for smooth, three-dimensional incompressible fluids, addressing cases C and D of the Clay Mathematics Institute's official problem statement.

The solution was generated by an unreleased internal model superior to GPT-6 Astra, which coordinated approximately 10,000 concurrent agents. The system took about 88 hours to produce the candidate solution, followed by 17 hours of Lean formalization and verification by GPT-6 Astra. The entire project generated roughly 2.7 million agent messages and 130 billion output tokens.

The announcement has sparked some controversy. NYU mathematics professor Tristan Buckmaster questioned whether OpenAI utilized data from his Euler equation research with Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge. OpenAI stated that no specific user data was accessed, though it could not entirely rule out the use of de-identified data for model training. The company also noted that the two research projects target different mathematical problems.

The candidate solution has yet to undergo independent peer review. According to the Clay Mathematics Institute's rules, a solution must be published in a qualifying journal and withstand at least two years of rigorous scrutiny before being considered for the $1 million prize. OpenAI has stated it does not intend to claim the prize.

title_zh: DeepSeek Flash 系列 9 月 10 日起降价，V4.1 Flash 同步开启内测
content_zh:
DeepSeek 将于 9 月 10 日 12:00 起大幅调整 flash 系列模型定价，闲时输入价格从每百万 token 1.5 元降至 1 元，闲时输出价格从 4.5 元降至 4 元，闲时缓存价格从 0.05 元降至 0.02 元；高峰时段价格为闲时价格的 2 倍。

与此同时，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 中间版本已开放内测。参与内测的 API 用户无需更改 base_url，将模型名切换为「deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910」即可调用，当前计费与 DeepSeek V4 Flash 相同，单账号最多支持 20 并发请求。

该模型 ID 中的失效日期为 9 月 10 日，属短期内测版本，尚未替换官网 API 文档中的正式 V4 Flash 型号，新版本采用不同的模型架构，原生支持多模态，本轮测试重点为能力、生成速度和推理成本。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，DeepSeek 新模型突然上线，Flash 的模型，Pro 的野心
title_en: DeepSeek Slashes Flash Model Prices, Launches V4.1 Flash Closed Beta
content_en:
AI startup DeepSeek has announced significant price cuts for its Flash model series, effective September 10 at 12:00 PM (UTC+8). Off-peak pricing for input tokens will drop from 1.5 RMB to 1 RMB per million, while output tokens will decrease from 4.5 RMB to 4 RMB. Off-peak cache pricing will also be reduced from 0.05 RMB to 0.02 RMB. Peak-hour pricing will remain double the off-peak rates.

Alongside the price cuts, DeepSeek has launched a closed beta for its intermediate DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model. API users can test the model by switching the model name to `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` without changing their `base_url`. The beta model shares the same pricing structure as DeepSeek V4 Flash and supports up to 20 concurrent requests per account.

This short-term beta model, which expires on September 10, features a new architecture with native multimodal support. The current testing phase focuses on evaluating its capabilities, generation speed, and overall inference costs before it officially replaces the current V4 Flash model in the API documentation.

title_zh: 两部门要求车企定期报告供应商账期，重点企业每年接受评估
content_zh:
工业和信息化部、市场监管总局 9 月 7 日发布通知，进一步规范汽车企业向供应商支付采购货物、工程和服务等款项。车企需建立供应商账款支付管理制度，并在每年 7 月底和次年 1 月底前分别提交半年度、年度执行情况报告。

工信部将委托第三方机构每年开展一次调研评估，对名单内重点车企实现全覆盖。评估会查阅企业文件和数据、核验现场并访谈员工，关注账期、支付方式及占比、应付账款规模等信息，结果将公开发布。

对于应付账款规模较大、故意拉长账期或被中小企业投诉较多的车企，主管部门将约谈并督促整改；涉及违法违规的，将依法处理。此前行业在 2025 年发起「60 天账期承诺」，此次通知把企业报告、第三方评估、投诉核查和执法衔接写入常态化管理流程。
title_en: China Mandates Regular Payment Reports from Carmakers to Protect Suppliers
content_en:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) have issued a joint directive to regulate how automakers pay their suppliers for goods, engineering, and services. Under the new rules, car manufacturers must establish internal payment management systems and submit compliance reports twice a year—by the end of July and January.

To ensure compliance, the MIIT will commission third-party agencies to conduct annual audits of key automakers. These evaluations will inspect corporate documents, conduct on-site verifications, and interview employees, focusing on payment cycles, payment methods, and the scale of accounts payable. The findings will be made public.

Automakers with massive outstanding payments, those intentionally delaying payments, or those facing frequent complaints from small and medium-sized enterprises will face regulatory talks and corrective orders. Serious violations will be prosecuted. This directive formalizes reporting, third-party auditing, and law enforcement into a routine regulatory framework, reinforcing the industry's previous "60-day payment commitment" initiative.

title_zh: 小米中折叠「卖爆了」，首销较上代大折叠增长 310%
content_zh: 小米集团副总裁、CMO 许斐 9 月 8 日表示，小米 18 Fold 首销较上代大折叠增长 310%。这款中折叠手机前一晚发布，起售价为 10999 元，是小米目前定位最高的手机产品。
title_en: Xiaomi’s New Premium Foldable Debuts with a 310% Sales Surge
content_en:
Xiaomi's latest premium foldable smartphone, the Xiaomi 18 Fold, has achieved an explosive debut. Xu Fei, Vice President and CMO of Xiaomi Group, announced on September 8 that first-day sales of the new device skyrocketed by 310% compared to its predecessor.

Released just the night before, the high-end foldable starts at 10,999 RMB (approximately $1,550 USD). It currently stands as Xiaomi's most premium and highest-positioned smartphone product in its lineup.

title_zh: 曝微信 PC 版接入 AI 助手「小微」，可操作聊天与小程序
content_zh:
微信开始在 PC 版测试 AI 助手「小微」。它能查看朋友圈、发送消息、发起语音和视频通话，也能在聊天中回答文件内容；视频文件和定时消息暂不支持。

「小微」还能调用小程序完成订餐等服务，涉及支付时会交由用户确认。微信内置浏览器的「元宝总结」入口也被替换为「问 AI」，可继续围绕当前网页提问。

面向开发者的能力包括在 PC 端开发和调试小程序、生成体验版。个性化推荐默认关闭，用户可在设置中单独开启；目前没有提供关闭「小微」入口的选项。
title_en: WeChat Tests 'Xiaowei' AI Assistant on PC to Automate Chats and Mini Programs
content_en:
Tencent's WeChat has begun testing its proprietary AI assistant, "Xiaowei," on its PC client. The AI assistant is designed to perform various tasks, such as browsing Moments, sending messages, initiating voice and video calls, and answering questions based on chat files. However, it does not yet support video files or scheduled messages.

Xiaowei can also interact with WeChat Mini Programs to execute tasks like ordering food, though any payment actions will require manual user confirmation. Additionally, the "Yuanbao Summary" feature in WeChat's built-in browser has been rebranded to "Ask AI," allowing users to query the AI about the webpage they are currently viewing.

For developers, the update introduces capabilities to develop, debug, and generate trial versions of Mini Programs directly on the PC client. While personalized recommendations are turned off by default and can be enabled in settings, users currently do not have the option to completely disable the Xiaowei assistant interface.

title_zh: 蔚来与云南交投新一批高速换电站投运，覆盖 5 条高速双向服务区
content_zh:
蔚来能源与云南交投 9 月 8 日宣布，双方新一批共建高速换电站已全面投入运营。站点分别落在 G5621 昆楚大高速地索坪、G85 银昆高速会泽、G78 汕昆高速师宗、G5 京昆高速元谋和 G8511 昆磨高速通关服务区，5 处服务区均完成双向布点。

这是双方继 2024 年首批合作后的新一轮投运。新站点连接滇中、滇东、滇西和滇南主要通道，补齐省内跨区域、长距离行程中的高速换电节点。双方后续还将推进高速「光储充换」综合能源站和零碳服务区。

截至 9 月 8 日，蔚来称其已建成 9328 座充换电站，其中换电站 4075 座、充电站 5253 座，配备 30284 根充电桩；累计完成超 1.2 亿次换电服务，充换电服务合计超 2 亿次。
title_en: NIO and Yunnan Communications Investment Launch New Expressway Battery Swap Stations
content_en:
NIO Power and Yunnan Communications Investment Group announced on September 8 that their latest batch of co-built high-speed battery swap stations is now fully operational. The new stations are strategically located across five major expressways—G5621, G85, G78, G5, and G8511—covering service areas in both directions.

This launch marks the latest milestone in their ongoing partnership, connecting key corridors in central, eastern, western, and southern Yunnan Province. The expansion aims to address charging and swapping needs for long-distance, cross-regional travel within the province. Looking ahead, the two companies plan to develop integrated "solar-storage-charging-swapping" energy stations and zero-carbon service areas.

As of September 8, NIO has built a massive network of 9,328 charging and swapping stations globally, including 4,075 battery swap stations and 5,253 charging stations equipped with over 30,284 chargers. The company has completed over 120 million battery swaps and more than 200 million total charging and swapping services.

title_zh: DeepSeek 新开约 150 个工程岗位，聚焦后端与 Agent 弹性计算
content_zh:
DeepSeek Harness 团队负责人崔添翼 9 月 7 日公开招聘约 150 人。这批名额主要面向有 2 至 10 年经验的工程师，也接受应届生和初入行从业者；工作地点以北京为主，部分岗位可选杭州。

招聘集中在服务端开发和 Agent 弹性计算研发两类岗位。前者覆盖大模型研究平台、Agent 框架组件、研发效率基建、DeepSeek API、线上服务和数据工程；后者包括平台开发维护与底层系统调优。本轮没有单列 AI 研究岗位。

崔添翼解释称，数据、机器与容器、训练和评测任务、Agent 环境以及用户请求都在增长，原有后端系统需要升级、维护甚至重写。此前 6 月，DeepSeek 曾宣布计划将各部门规模至少扩大一倍；此次招聘的岗位范围更集中。
title_en: DeepSeek Launches Recruitment Drive for 150 Engineering Roles in Backend and Agent Computing
content_en:
DeepSeek's Harness team lead, Cui Tianyi, announced a recruitment drive on September 7 to hire approximately 150 engineers. The roles primarily target professionals with 2 to 10 years of experience, though fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are also welcome. Most positions will be based in Beijing, with select roles available in Hangzhou.

The hiring push focuses on two main areas: backend server development and Agent elastic computing R&D. Backend roles will cover large language model (LLM) research platforms, Agent framework components, R&D infrastructure, the DeepSeek API, online services, and data engineering. Elastic computing roles will focus on platform maintenance and low-level system optimization. Notably, no dedicated AI research positions are included in this round.

According to Cui, the recruitment is driven by the rapid growth of data, machine containers, training and evaluation tasks, Agent environments, and user requests, which have created a pressing need to upgrade or rewrite existing backend systems. This targeted hiring follows DeepSeek's June announcement of plans to at least double the size of its various departments.

title_zh: 高通与亚马逊达成多代定制芯片合作，覆盖 AI 推理与 1.6T 光互联
content_zh:
高通 9 月 8 日宣布与亚马逊达成多代产品合作，双方将为 AWS 的大规模 AI 数据中心开发定制芯片，并共同推进 AI 推理基础设施。合作还将覆盖最高 1.6T 的光互联及后续方案。

高通将提供 SerDes、光学 DSP、低功耗计算和系统集成能力，用于提升数据中心内部高带宽互联。亚马逊则提供云端 AI 基础设施，双方希望在计算、存储、网络带宽和能效之间形成一套可扩展方案。

高通还计划扩大对 AWS AI 基础设施和 Amazon Bedrock 的使用，把它们用于电子设计自动化工作负载，以缩短芯片设计周期。
title_en: Qualcomm and Amazon Partner on Custom Chips for AI Inference and 1.6T Optical Interconnects
content_en:
Qualcomm announced a multi-generation partnership with Amazon on September 8 to develop custom silicon for AWS's large-scale AI data centers and jointly advance AI inference infrastructure. The collaboration will also focus on high-speed optical interconnects of up to 1.6T and future scaling solutions.

Under the agreement, Qualcomm will leverage its expertise in SerDes, optical DSPs, low-power computing, and system integration to enhance high-bandwidth connectivity within data centers. Amazon will provide its cloud AI infrastructure, with both companies aiming to deliver a scalable solution that balances computing power, storage, network bandwidth, and energy efficiency.

Additionally, Qualcomm plans to expand its use of AWS's AI infrastructure and Amazon Bedrock for its Electronic Design Automation (EDA) workloads, aiming to accelerate and streamline its own chip design cycles.

title_zh: 《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》12 月 8 日停运，日文原版不受影响
content_zh:
《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》9 月 8 日宣布，因 IP 授权合作到期，游戏将于 12 月 8 日 18:00 正式停止运营。当日 14:00 起，全平台下载入口、充值和新用户注册已经关闭。

停运后，所有账号数据和角色资料将被清空。近 3 个月内充值获得且未消耗的付费三叶草可在 9 月 8 日至 12 月 8 日期间申请退款，官服用户可通过游戏内客服提交，渠道服和 iOS 用户需联系对应渠道。

中国版由灵犀互娱在 2018 年获得 Hit-Point 授权后推出。此次停运只涉及《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》，Hit-Point 运营的日文原版《旅かえる》仍在正常运营。
title_en: 'Travel Frog: China Journey' to Shut Down in December
content_en:
The Chinese adaptation of the hit mobile game *Travel Frog* (*旅行青蛙·中国之旅*) will officially shut down on December 8 at 18:00, following the expiration of its IP licensing agreement. Downloads, in-app purchases, and new user registrations were disabled on September 8.

Upon shutdown, all account data and character progress will be permanently deleted. Players who purchased paid "clovers" within the last three months can apply for refunds between September 8 and December 8. Official server users can submit requests via in-game customer service, while channel and iOS users must contact their respective platforms.

Launched in 2018 by Lingxi Games under license from Japanese developer Hit-Point, the shutdown only affects the Chinese localized version. The original Japanese version, *Tabikaeru*, operated by Hit-Point, will continue to run normally.

title_zh: Meta 发布个人 AI Agent Muse，可持续代办邮件、旅行和购物
content_zh:
Meta 9 月 8 日发布个人 AI Agent Muse。用户可在独立应用或 WhatsApp 中与它对话，让其拆解目标、制定计划，并在用户关闭应用后继续执行任务。

Muse 由 Muse Spark 模型驱动，可打开浏览器、填写表单、发送邮件、预订旅行和完成购物。它还能连接 Instagram 等 Meta 产品与第三方应用，例如将用户保存的食谱 Reels 整理成采购清单，或在宴请前根据宾客饮食偏好生成菜单。

为隔离 Agent 与用户数据，Meta 为每个 Muse 配置专用云端 Muse Secure VM，并让一个与主 Agent 系统隔离的 Sentinel 审查对外请求。发送邮件、付款等敏感动作需用户确认，账号密码和支付信息存入独立安全区，Muse 本身无法查看。用户可选择关联的应用和权限，也可退出将互动用于模型训练。

Muse 已在美国面向 iOS、Android 和网页用户陆续开放，后续将登陆 Meta AI 眼镜。基础功能主要免费，Meta 同时准备面向高强度使用者的订阅方案。
title_en: Meta Launches 'Muse' AI Agent to Automate Emails, Travel, and Shopping
content_en:
Meta has unveiled "Muse," a personal AI agent designed to break down goals, plan tasks, and execute them in the background—even after the user closes the app. Powered by the Muse Spark model, Muse can be accessed via a standalone app or WhatsApp.

The AI agent is capable of browsing the web, filling out forms, sending emails, booking travel, and making purchases. It also integrates with Meta's ecosystem and third-party apps. For example, it can convert saved Instagram Reels recipes into shopping lists or generate dinner party menus based on guests' dietary restrictions.

To address privacy concerns, Meta isolates each user's agent within a dedicated cloud environment called Muse Secure VM. An independent "Sentinel" system reviews all external requests, and sensitive actions like sending emails or processing payments require explicit user confirmation. Account credentials and payment details are stored in a separate secure enclave inaccessible to Muse itself. Users can manage app permissions and opt out of data training.

Muse is currently rolling out to iOS, Android, and web users in the U.S., with plans to bring the assistant to Meta AI glasses. While basic features are free, Meta plans to introduce a subscription tier for heavy users.

title_zh: Robinhood 首次进入 IPO 承销团，参与 Oura 上市
content_zh:
智能戒指公司 Oura 向美国证券交易委员会提交的招股书显示，Robinhood 已进入其 IPO 承销商名单，与高盛、摩根士丹利、摩根大通、Allen \& Company 和 Jefferies 等机构共同参与发行。《华尔街日报》称，这是 Robinhood 第一次正式担任 IPO 承销商。

Robinhood 从 2021 年开始向散户客户分配新股，但过去主要承担分销角色。进入承销团后，它能更早参与发行安排，也有机会在留给平台客户的份额上获得更大发言权。Oura 计划以「OURA」为股票代码在纳斯达克上市，招股书尚未填入发行价和发行股数。

这次安排也让 Robinhood 从面向散户的交易平台进一步进入传统投行业务。不过，Oura 面向员工及指定人士的定向配售项目仍由摩根士丹利管理，Robinhood 的具体承销份额尚未公布。
title_en: Robinhood Debuts as IPO Underwriter in Oura's Nasdaq Listing
content_en:
Robinhood has joined the underwriting syndicate for smart ring maker Oura's upcoming initial public offering (IPO), marking the retail brokerage's debut as an official IPO underwriter. According to Oura's filing with the SEC, Robinhood will work alongside Wall Street giants including Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Allen & Company, and Jefferies.

While Robinhood has allowed retail investors to buy into IPOs since 2021, it previously acted solely as a distributor. Joining the underwriting syndicate allows the company to participate in early-stage deal structuring and potentially secure a larger say in the share allocation reserved for its platform users.

This milestone represents a significant step for Robinhood as it expands from a retail-focused platform into traditional investment banking. Oura plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "OURA," though the pricing and number of shares have not yet been disclosed. Morgan Stanley will continue to manage Oura's directed share program for employees and designated associates, and Robinhood's exact underwriting share remains undisclosed.

title_zh: Mistral 完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超 210 亿欧元
content_zh:
法国 AI 公司 Mistral 9 月 8 日宣布完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元。公司称，这是欧洲科技公司迄今完成的最大单轮股权融资。

本轮融资由三星电子领投，EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 与现有投资者 PSG Equity 共同领投；Advent、贝莱德管理的基金和卢森堡大公国加入投资，ASML、英伟达、a16z、法国公共投资银行、Salesforce Ventures 等现有股东继续跟投。

Mistral 表示，资金将用于前沿模型研究、训练算力、基础设施扩建，以及商业和国际业务增长。公司目前在 20 个国家开展业务，为空中客车、ASML、汇丰等超过 125 家企业提供 AI 服务。
title_en: French AI Startup Mistral Raises €3 Billion Series D, Valuation Surpasses €21 Billion
content_en:
French artificial intelligence startup Mistral has announced the completion of a €3 billion Series D funding round, pushing its post-money valuation past €21 billion. The company stated that this represents the largest single equity financing round for a European technology company to date.

The funding round was led by Samsung Electronics, EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund, and existing investor PSG Equity. Other participants included Advent, funds managed by BlackRock, and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. Existing shareholders, including ASML, Nvidia, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Bpifrance, and Salesforce Ventures, also participated.

Mistral plans to use the fresh capital to advance its frontier model research, expand training compute and infrastructure, and accelerate its commercial and international growth. The company currently operates in 20 countries, providing AI services to over 125 enterprise clients, including Airbus, ASML, and HSBC.

title_zh: 💡 梁琛奇：AI 娱乐产品要让消费过程实时使用算力
content_zh:
字节跳动前 AI 产品团队 Flow 负责人梁琛奇接受《晚点》采访时表示，AI 娱乐产品若只降低内容生产成本，产出的短剧、漫画或视频仍会回到既有平台；新的独立平台需要让用户在消费过程中实时与模型互动，并获得过去不存在的长尾反馈。

他把 AI 娱乐的成立条件归纳为成本、模态和用户习惯。DeepSeek-R1 之后，推理成本继续下降；图片和视频模型跨过可用门槛；用户也已经通过 ChatGPT、豆包等产品学会与 AI 交互。基于这些变化，他判断娱乐产品可以从静态生成转向一边消费、一边生成图片、视频或玩法。

梁琛奇创办的「动念引线」正在同时开发和测试七八个产品，由一两人的小组在两周至一个月内做出 Demo，再按真实用户信号决定关停或追加资源。其首款产品「松果时刻」可把照片和文字扩展为带配音、配乐和简单动画的多图故事；团队下一步会把内容收向特定人群，并尝试让消费端也实时调用模型。

他认为，AI 娱乐仍离不开人的主观表达：模型擅长根据用户偏好生成「熟悉感」，真正的惊喜和内容多样性则来自创作者。产品成立需要同时满足新颖、长期、高频和不易厌倦，并在留存与使用频次上形成可持续信号。
title_en: Former ByteDance AI Lead Liang Chenqi: AI Entertainment Must Enable Real-Time Compute During Consumption
content_en:
In a recent interview with *LatePost*, Liang Chenqi, the former head of ByteDance's AI product team "Flow," shared his insights on the future of AI entertainment. Liang argued that simply lowering content production costs is not enough for new AI entertainment platforms to succeed. If they only focus on cheaper production, the resulting content—such as short dramas, comics, or videos—will inevitably flow back to existing dominant platforms. Instead, successful independent platforms must allow users to interact with AI models in real-time during consumption, generating unique, long-tail feedback.

Liang outlined three critical factors for the viability of AI entertainment: cost, modality, and user habits. Following the release of DeepSeek-R1, reasoning costs have continued to decline, while image and video models have crossed the threshold of practical usability. Furthermore, users have already grown accustomed to interacting with AI through products like ChatGPT and Doubao. Consequently, Liang believes AI entertainment is shifting from static generation to dynamic, real-time creation of images, videos, or gameplay during active consumption.

His startup, Dongnian Yinxian (动念引线), is currently developing and testing seven to eight products simultaneously. Small teams of one or two people build demos within two to four weeks, and the company decides whether to shut down or allocate more resources based on real user feedback. Their first product, "Songguo Shike" (松果时刻), converts photos and text into multi-image stories complete with voiceovers, music, and simple animations. The team's next step is to narrow their target audience and experiment with real-time model invocation on the consumer side.

Ultimately, Liang believes that human expression remains indispensable in AI entertainment. While models excel at generating "familiarity" based on user preferences, true surprises and content diversity must come from human creators. To succeed, products must be novel, sustainable, high-frequency, and engaging over the long term.

title_zh: 荣耀 Magic9 Pro Max 绿色外观曝光，后摄采用「1+2」转塔布局
content_zh:
荣耀 Magic9 Pro Max 的绿色机身渲染图 9 月 8 日在社交平台流出。图中机身采用金属与背板拼接设计，镜头模组为左侧大圆与右侧两个小圆组成的「1+2」排列；左侧区域还出现了潜望镜头、闪光灯和 ARRI 标识。

这套外观被描述为参考 ARRI ARRIFLEX 电影机的三镜头转塔结构。荣耀已确认与 ARRI 的技术合作会应用于下一代 Magic9 系列，但流出图所示的配色、机身结构与摄像头配置尚未获官方确认。

同一批爆料还列出 6.8 英寸级 LTPO OLED 直屏、3D 人脸识别和双 2 亿像素主摄、潜望长焦等参数。这些规格仍属未证实信息，此次曝光的可确认新增点主要是绿色机身与转塔式后摄布局。
title_en: Honor Magic9 Pro Max Leaks Reveal Green Colorway and ARRI-Inspired '1+2' Turret Camera Layout
content_en:
Leaked renders of the Honor Magic9 Pro Max surfaced on social media on September 8, showcasing a new green colorway and a distinctive rear camera design. The device features a hybrid metal-and-glass backplate, with a camera module arranged in a "1+2" turret layout—consisting of one large circle on the left and two smaller circles on the right. The left section also houses a periscope lens, a flash, and the ARRI logo.

This unique aesthetic is reportedly inspired by the three-lens turret structure of ARRI ARRIFLEX movie cameras. While Honor has officially confirmed its technical partnership with ARRI for the upcoming Magic9 series, the specific colorway, body structure, and camera configurations shown in the leaks have not yet been officially verified.

Other leaked specifications circulating alongside the renders include a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED flat screen, 3D face recognition, and dual 200-megapixel main and periscope telephoto sensors. While these specifications remain unconfirmed, the leak highlights the green design and the turret-style rear camera layout as key new features.

title_zh: MagicOS 11 定档 9 月 15 日发布，主打系统级 Agent
content_zh:
荣耀公布 2026 全球开发者大会日程，MagicOS 11 将于 9 月 15 日 19:00 至 20:00 在深圳发布。官方把新系统定位为系统级 Agent 商用落地，并安排 AI、游戏和智慧家庭等分论坛继续介绍开发能力。

已经公布的系统变化包括全新液态玻璃视觉效果、无损压缩与冗余文件清理、多协议快充适配，以及由 AI 选择网络的弱网优化。荣耀称，全系列机型的整机流畅度将提升 20% 以上，并加入 4K Live「录中拍」功能。

荣耀尚未列出兼容机型和具体升级批次。这场开发者大会将持续一天，系统发布安排在晚间主论坛。
title_en: Honor to Launch MagicOS 11 on September 15, Featuring System-Level AI Agent
content_en:
Honor has announced the schedule for its 2026 Global Developer Conference, revealing that MagicOS 11 will officially launch on September 15 in Shenzhen. Positioned as a commercial milestone for system-level AI Agents, the new operating system will be accompanied by dedicated developer sessions focusing on AI, gaming, and smart home capabilities.

Key upgrades in MagicOS 11 include a brand-new "liquid glass" visual design, lossless compression, redundant file cleanup, and support for multi-protocol fast charging. The system also introduces AI-driven network optimization for weak signal environments. Honor claims that overall system smoothness across all compatible devices will improve by over 20%, alongside the addition of a new 4K Live "record-while-shooting" feature.

While the full list of compatible devices and rollout schedules has not yet been disclosed, the launch event will headline the evening session of the day-long developer conference.

title_zh: iQOO 16 与 iQOO Pad Ultra 定档 9 月底发布
content_zh:
iQOO 宣布，iQOO 16 手机与 iQOO Pad Ultra 平板将在 9 月底同场发布。官方预热视频展示了两款产品的名称和背部设计，手机继续采用方形相机模组，平板则使用居中的矩阵式镜头区域。

现有爆料称，iQOO 16 将采用 6.8 英寸直屏、第五代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器和 2 亿像素潜望长焦，电池容量可能超过 7000mAh；iQOO Pad Ultra 则可能搭载天玑 9600、14 英寸屏幕和 16000mAh 电池。这些参数尚未得到官方确认。

认证信息显示，iQOO 16 预计支持 66W 有线充电。iQOO 将在月底发布会上公布完整配置和销售安排。
title_en: iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra Set for Late September Launch
content_en:
iQOO has officially announced that the iQOO 16 smartphone and the iQOO Pad Ultra tablet will be launched together in late September. A teaser video released by the company showcases the design of both devices, featuring a square camera module on the phone and a centered matrix camera layout on the tablet.

According to leaks, the iQOO 16 is rumored to sport a 6.8-inch flat display, the Snapdragon 8 Elite processor, a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens, and a massive battery exceeding 7,000mAh with 66W wired fast charging support. Meanwhile, the iQOO Pad Ultra is rumored to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 chipset, a 14-inch display, and a colossal 16,000mAh battery.

These specifications remain unconfirmed by the company. iQOO is expected to reveal the official configurations, pricing, and availability during the launch event at the end of the month.

title_zh: 智象未来 vivago R1 全球上线，主打 5 分钟长视频生成
content_zh:
智象未来（HiDream.ai）昨日宣布旗下内容创作 AI 智能体 vivago R1 全球正式上线，其国内版本「够搭」同步升级。

官方数据显示，目前 vivago.ai 全球用户量已突破 7000 万。与行业主流 15 至 30 秒的短片段生成不同，vivago R1 主打长视频创作，支持一次性稳定输出 5 分钟高质量视频，并具备无限次多轮延长能力。

产品采用「对话优先」（Chat-First）模式，用户无需调节复杂的节点与参数，通过自然语言对话即可驱动视频生成与修改。

底层架构上，产品依托自研 HD-AgentOS 进行任务拆解与多 Agent 协同，官方称内容有效可用成功率提升至 85%，有效缓解了跨镜头人物和场景不一致的问题。目前 vivago R1 已面向全球用户开放体验。

🔗 相关阅读：实测全球上线的 vivago R1，我用它打造了一部赛博西游记短片
title_en: HiDream.ai Launches vivago R1 Globally, Enabling 5-Minute AI Video Generation
content_en:
HiDream.ai has announced the global launch of its AI content creation agent, vivago R1, alongside an upgrade to its domestic Chinese counterpart, "Gouda." The platform, vivago.ai, has already amassed over 70 million users worldwide.

Unlike mainstream AI video generators that typically produce 15-to-30-second clips, vivago R1 specializes in long-form video creation. It supports the generation of high-quality, stable 5-minute videos in a single run, with the capability for infinite multi-round extensions.

The tool features a "Chat-First" interface, allowing users to generate and edit videos using natural language prompts instead of tweaking complex parameters or nodes. Under the hood, vivago R1 is powered by HiDream's proprietary HD-AgentOS, which coordinates multiple AI agents to break down tasks. This architecture boosts the generation success rate to 85% and significantly mitigates the common issue of character and scene inconsistency across different shots.

title_zh: 9999 元，索尼发布首款全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头 FE 8-14mm F3.5 G
content_zh:
索尼（中国）有限公司昨日正式发布旗下首款全画幅鱼眼变焦 G 镜头 FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G（型号：SEL814G）。

该镜头将索尼 E 卡口原厂镜头的广角端拓展至 8mm，填补了索尼全画幅鱼眼镜头的产品空白，官方建议零售价为 9999 元，将于 9 月中旬正式上市。
title_en: Sony Unveils Its First Full-Frame Fisheye Zoom Lens for 9,999 RMB
content_en:
Sony China has officially announced its first full-frame fisheye zoom G lens, the **FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G** (model SEL814G).

This new lens extends the wide-angle capabilities of Sony’s native E-mount lineup to 8mm, filling a key gap in its full-frame lens portfolio. The lens is priced at 9,999 RMB and is scheduled to hit the market in mid-September.

title_zh: Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 开放邀测，可直接交付 PPT 和交互网页
content_zh:
小米技术 9 月 8 日宣布，Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 桌面客户端开放邀测。申请通过的用户可在测试期间限时、限量免费使用 MiMo-X-Pro-Preview 与 MiMo-X-Flash-Preview 两款新模型。

MiMo Desktop 可接收多种格式的素材，拆分目标并调用工具，最后交付可继续编辑的 PPT、Office 文件、网页和轻量游戏等成果。它支持在会话内预览页面交互，也能通过 MCP 操作 Figma，或直接控制浏览器检索、填写表单和提取素材。

用户可选中成果里的文字、图表或页面区域局部重新生成，每次修改会保留版本记录。内置的「Smart」模式会根据任务类型和复杂度，在不同模型、Agent 与 Skill 路径之间调度；大型任务还可拆给多个独立会话协同处理。
title_en: Xiaomi Launches MiMo Desktop Beta, Enabling Direct Creation of PPTs and Interactive Web Pages
content_en:
Xiaomi Technology has opened invitation-only beta testing for its new desktop client, **Xiaomi MiMo Desktop**. Approved beta testers will get limited-time, free access to two new AI models: *MiMo-X-Pro-Preview* and *MiMo-X-Flash-Preview*.

MiMo Desktop is designed to process various input formats, break down complex goals, and automatically generate fully editable outputs, including PowerPoint presentations, Office documents, interactive web pages, and lightweight games. The platform allows users to preview page interactions directly within the chat interface. It also supports Figma integration via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and can automate browser tasks such as searching, filling out forms, and extracting assets.

Additionally, users can select specific text, charts, or page regions to regenerate, with the system maintaining a complete version history of all modifications. An intelligent "Smart" mode dynamically routes tasks to different models, agents, and skill paths based on complexity, while larger projects can be split across multiple collaborative sessions.

title_zh: WhatsApp 测试接入第三方 AI Agent，单个账号最多连接 5 个
content_zh:
WhatsApp 正在 Android 测试版中开发第三方 AI Agent 接入功能。用户可在应用内创建专用机器人会话，WhatsApp 会生成 API Key，再由用户把密钥填入对应的 Agent 平台，使本地或云端运行的 Agent 直接在聊天窗口接收指令和返回结果。

每个账号目前最多可连接 5 个 Agent，并能分别设置名称和头像。Agent 只能读取用户主动发到该专用会话中的内容，不能访问其他聊天、联系人或媒体，也暂时不能加入群聊和社区。

这项功能尚未广泛开放，当前只向部分 Android 用户提供。需要留意的是，第三方 Agent 会话现阶段不支持端到端加密；WhatsApp 也会提示 AI 回复可能不准确，用户需自行核对结果。
title_en: WhatsApp Tests Third-Party AI Agent Integration on Android
content_en:
WhatsApp is testing a new feature in its Android beta that allows users to connect to third-party AI agents. Users can set up dedicated bot chats within the app, which generates an API key. By inputting this key into external agent platforms, users can interact with local or cloud-based AI agents directly inside WhatsApp.

Currently, users can connect up to five different agents per account, each with customizable names and profile pictures. To protect user privacy, these agents can only access messages sent directly to their specific chat window. They cannot access other chats, contacts, or media files, and they are currently restricted from joining group chats or communities.

The feature is currently limited to select Android beta testers. Users should note that these third-party agent chats do not support end-to-end encryption, and WhatsApp warns that AI-generated responses may not always be accurate.

title_zh: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM5-2B，AA v4.2 评测位列 4B 以下开源模型第一
content_zh:
面壁智能发布并开源 MiniCPM5-2B。这是一款 26 亿参数的稠密模型，Artificial Analysis 的 Intelligence Index v4.2 得分为 15，在该机构收录的 40 亿参数以下开源权重模型中排名第一。

MiniCPM5-2B 支持 13.1 万 token 上下文，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，可部署在手机、平板和边缘设备上。模型卡同时提供预训练、监督微调、强化学习和量化版本，方便开发者按不同算力条件使用。

Artificial Analysis 的细项测试中，MiniCPM5-2B 在 GDPval-AA 获得 831 分，在 Agentic Index 的 Terminal-Bench Hard 和 τ²-Bench Telecom 汇总项中获得 34 分，在 Briefcase Index 获得 438 分。面壁智能宣传材料引用的 23 分来自旧版 v4.1.1 指标，不能与当前 v4.2 得分直接比较。
title_en: ModelBest Open-Sources MiniCPM5-2B, Topping Artificial Analysis Leaderboard for Under-4B Models
content_en:
ModelBest has officially released and open-sourced **MiniCPM5-2B**, a dense large language model featuring 2.6 billion parameters. According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2, the model scored 15, ranking first among all open-weight models under 4 billion parameters tracked by the platform.

MiniCPM5-2B supports a 131k-token context window and is released under the Apache 2.0 license, making it highly suitable for deployment on mobile phones, tablets, and edge devices. To accommodate various computing constraints, ModelBest has provided multiple versions of the model, including pre-trained, supervised fine-tuned (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and quantized formats.

In detailed benchmarks by Artificial Analysis, MiniCPM5-2B scored 831 on GDPval-AA, 34 on the Agentic Index (combining Terminal-Bench Hard and τ²-Bench Telecom), and 438 on the Briefcase Index. Note that the score of 23 cited in some of ModelBest's promotional materials refers to the older v4.1.1 index and is not directly comparable to the current v4.2 score.

title_zh: ChatGPT Images 2.5 上线，新增草图生成与局部批注编辑
content_zh:
OpenAI 9 月 8 日发布 ChatGPT Images 2.5。官方称，新模型重点改进了参考图主体保真度、局部编辑精度和多轮修改一致性，生成延迟最高比 Images 2.0 降低 50%。

ChatGPT 同步新增 Sketch、模板和图片批注功能。用户可输入「@Sketch」直接画出构图或轮廓，再用文字指定风格和细节；也可从海报、商品照等模板开始制作，或在已生成图片上直接留下修改批注。新版还支持在分享图片时附带 prompt，方便他人使用自己的图片复刻同类效果。

Images 2.5 已向 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 各档用户在桌面端、移动端和网页端陆续开放。API 端则推出 GPT-Image-2.5 Flare 与 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst：前者面向高频、快速的图片工作流，后者强调高精度和多次编辑控制。生成图仍会携带 C2PA 元数据和不可见水印。
title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5 with Sketch-to-Image and In-Image Annotations
content_en:
OpenAI has officially launched **ChatGPT Images 2.5**. The updated model brings significant improvements to reference image fidelity, local editing precision, and consistency across multi-turn modifications. Additionally, generation latency has been reduced by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0.

The update introduces several new features, including **Sketch**, templates, and image annotations. By typing `@Sketch`, users can draw rough compositions or outlines and then use text prompts to define styles and details. Users can also start from templates like posters or product photos, or annotate directly on generated images to request specific edits. Furthermore, shared images can now include their original prompts, allowing others to easily replicate similar styles.

ChatGPT Images 2.5 is rolling out across desktop, mobile, and web platforms for ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users. For developers, OpenAI has introduced two API models: **GPT-Image-2.5 Flare**, designed for high-frequency, fast-paced workflows, and **GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst**, which prioritizes high precision and multi-edit control. All generated images will continue to include C2PA metadata and invisible watermarking.

title_zh: McKinley 1.0 发布，可直接设计并导出自定义 SF Symbols
content_zh:
面向 Apple 开发者和设计师的 McKinley 1.0 正式发布。它把矢量绘图、符号结构标注、预览和导出整合到一个应用中，用户可以从 SVG 导入图形，也可以从空白画布开始制作自定义 SF Symbols。

McKinley 能在多种字重、尺寸和颜色配置间复用同一组对象，并调用 Apple 的渲染器实时预览结果。完成设计后，符号可直接导出到 Xcode，无需再回到 Apple 的 SF Symbols 应用处理模板和注释。

产品官网称，首发优惠会持续到英国夏令时 9 月 14 日中午。
title_en: McKinley 1.0 Released: Design and Export Custom SF Symbols Directly to Xcode
content_en:
**McKinley 1.0**, a new utility designed for Apple developers and designers, has officially launched. The application streamlines the creation of custom SF Symbols by integrating vector drawing, symbol structure annotation, real-time previewing, and exporting into a single, cohesive workflow. Users can import existing SVG graphics or design custom symbols from scratch.

McKinley allows creators to reuse the same set of vector objects across various weights, sizes, and color configurations. It leverages Apple's native renderer to provide instant, accurate previews. Once a design is complete, symbols can be exported directly into Xcode, eliminating the need to use Apple's standalone SF Symbols app to manage templates and annotations.

According to the official website, an introductory launch discount is available until noon BST on September 14.

title_zh: 豆包博物馆讲解模式新增 12 种方言
content_zh:
豆包的博物馆讲解模式新增 12 种方言，用户可以在展馆内拍摄展品，再选择方言获得语音讲解。豆包同时为该模式增加了新的博物馆相关身份入口。

这项功能建立在今年 6 月上线的博物馆讲解模式之上。首批合作覆盖 20 多家博物馆，豆包曾选取 5 件展品制作讲解，并与 7 家文化机构联合开展活动；上海浦东美术馆当时已有 2 件展品接入。

新增方言后，讲解模式从识别展品和生成背景介绍，进一步扩展到地区化语音呈现。具体支持的方言名单和覆盖展馆仍以豆包客户端为准。
title_en: Doubao AI Assistant Adds 12 Dialects to Its Museum Guide Feature
content_en:
ByteDance's AI assistant, Doubao, has updated its museum guide mode by adding support for 12 Chinese dialects. Visitors can now take photos of museum exhibits and select their preferred dialect to receive localized audio explanations. The update also introduces a new dedicated entry point for museum-related features.

This new capability builds on the museum guide mode launched in June, which initially partnered with over 20 museums and seven cultural institutions. The addition of regional dialects elevates the feature from simple exhibit recognition and background generation to a more personalized, localized audio experience.

title_zh: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》定档 11 月 5 日，登陆 Switch 2
content_zh:
任天堂在 9 月 8 日举行的《塞尔达传说》40 周年直面会上宣布，《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》将于 11 月 5 日登陆 Switch 2，提供数字版和实体版，并已开放预购。首发实体版采用特殊纹理烫箔包装，数量有限。

系列制作人青沼英二在直面会上演示了城镇、野外探索、战斗和音乐演奏等内容。重制版保留原作的时间旅行与地下城结构，并重新制作画面、操控和部分便利性功能。

直面会前，任天堂澳洲 eShop 搜索结果曾短暂显示 AU$94.95 的售价；任天堂现已确认发售日和版本安排，但其他地区价格仍以当地商店为准。原作于 1998 年登陆 Nintendo 64，这是任天堂为系列 40 周年准备的重点作品之一。
title_en: "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake" Set for November 5 Release on Switch 2
content_en:
During *The Legend of Zelda* 40th Anniversary Direct on September 8, Nintendo announced that *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake* will launch on November 5 for the highly anticipated "Switch 2." The game is now available for pre-order in both digital and physical formats, with the initial physical run featuring a limited-edition textured foil packaging.

Series producer Eiji Aonuma showcased gameplay during the event, demonstrating updated towns, overworld exploration, combat, and music performance. While the remake retains the iconic time-travel mechanics and dungeon layouts of the 1998 Nintendo 64 original, it features completely overhauled graphics, modernized controls, and various quality-of-life improvements.

title_zh: 喜茶恢复合伙人申请入口，客服称尚未正式重启加盟
content_zh:
喜茶 GO 小程序近日重新上线「我要成为合伙人」入口，这是品牌自 2025 年 2 月暂停新加盟申请后，官方申请渠道首次恢复显示。入口同步更新了申请须知，增加理性评估、审慎投资和如实填报资料等风险提示。

喜茶客服表示，目前尚未正式重新开放合伙事宜，申请人可以先填写信息，待项目再次开放后由品牌联系；提交申请也不代表已经建立合作关系，喜茶可在审核环节驳回不符合标准的申请。

喜茶于 2022 年 11 月首次开放事业合伙人模式，2025 年初以「拒绝无意义规模内卷」为由暂停新增申请，并开始清退低效门店。此次变化目前只确认了申请入口恢复，尚未公布新的加盟政策和开放时间。
title_en: Heytea Restores Franchise Application Portal, But Official Reopening Yet to Begin
content_en:
Chinese tea chain Heytea has restored the "Become a Partner" application portal on its "Heytea GO" mini-program. This marks the first time the official application channel has been visible since the brand suspended new franchise applications in February 2025. The updated portal now includes prominent risk warnings, advising applicants to make rational evaluations and prudent investment decisions.

Despite the portal's return, Heytea's customer service clarified that the franchise program has not officially resumed. Prospective partners can submit their information to be contacted once the program reopens, but submission does not guarantee a partnership, and Heytea reserves the right to reject applications during the review process.

Heytea first introduced its franchise model in November 2022 but paused it in early 2025 to "avoid meaningless scale competition" and phase out underperforming stores. While the application link is back online, the brand has yet to announce new franchise policies or an official relaunch date.

title_zh: 霸王茶姬在上海 7 家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点 5 元
content_zh:
霸王茶姬 9 月 7 日至 21 日在上海 7 家门店试卖茶叶蛋，单点售价 5 元，随饮品加购价为 2.5 元。产品只限堂食，上午 10:30 前与饮品组成套餐还可享受八折优惠。

这次测试目前只在上海进行，门店包括万象城、来福士等商圈门店。霸王茶姬没有公布是否会扩展到其他城市，也没有说明试卖结束后的长期安排。

品牌此前已在部分门店按早餐、午后和晚间时段增加食品。茶叶蛋进一步把传统便利店和早餐店常见单品带进茶饮门店，目标是增加非高峰时段的到店消费。
title_en: Chagee Trials Tea Eggs at Shanghai Outlets to Boost Off-Peak Sales
content_en:
Chinese tea chain Chagee is trialing a classic breakfast staple—tea eggs—at seven of its Shanghai locations from September 7 to September 21. A single tea egg is priced at 5 RMB, but customers can add one to a beverage order for a discounted price of 2.5 RMB. The item is available for dine-in only, and customers ordering a breakfast combo before 10:30 AM can receive a 20% discount.

The trial is currently limited to select high-traffic Shanghai shopping hubs, including The MixC and Raffles City. Chagee has not yet announced whether this offering will expand to other cities or become a permanent menu item.

This move follows Chagee's previous efforts to introduce food items tailored for breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening slots. By bringing a staple typically found in convenience stores and traditional breakfast joints into its tea shops, Chagee aims to drive foot traffic during non-peak hours.

title_zh: 4 小时纪录片《马斯克》发布预告，10 月 16 日北美上映
content_zh:
Alex Gibney 执导的纪录片《Musk》发布首支预告，并于威尼斯电影节首映。影片时长接近 4 小时，以 Elon Musk 的商业扩张、公众影响力和个人行事方式为主线，预告同时收录支持者的赞誉与批评者的尖锐评价。

Gibney 曾凭《驶向阴霾的出租》获得奥斯卡最佳纪录长片奖，也执导过《安然：房间里最聪明的人》《拨开迷雾：山达基教与信仰囚笼》和 Steve Jobs 纪录片《史蒂夫·乔布斯：机器人生》。他表示，新片不会简单裁定 Musk「好或坏」，而是考察其权力如何运作。

《Musk》将在 10 月 16 日由 Bleecker Street 于北美院线上映，之后登陆 HBO 和 HBO Max；威尼斯之后还会在多伦多电影节展映。
title_en: Four-Hour Elon Musk Documentary Trailer Released Ahead of October Release
content_en:
The first trailer for *Musk*, a nearly four-hour documentary directed by Oscar-winner Alex Gibney, has been released following its premiere at the Venice Film Festival. The film explores Elon Musk's business expansion, public influence, and personal conduct, featuring both high praise from supporters and sharp criticism from detractors.

Gibney, known for his Academy Award-winning *Taxi to the Dark Side* as well as acclaimed documentaries like *Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room*, *Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief*, and *Steve Jobs: The Man in the Machine*, stated that the film does not aim to label Musk as simply "good or bad." Instead, it seeks to examine how his immense power operates.

Distributed by Bleecker Street, *Musk* is scheduled for a North American theatrical release on October 16, after which it will stream on HBO and Max. Following its Venice debut, the documentary is also set to screen at the Toronto International Film Festival.

title_zh: 《世界之巅》上线，回望世贸中心顶层餐厅的 25 年
content_zh:
40 分钟纪录短片《世界之巅》（Top of the World）于 9 月 8 日上线 CNN。影片改编自 Tom Roston 的非虚构作品，由《女大法官金斯伯格》和《茱莉亚》的导演 Betsy West、Julie Cohen 执导，回顾世贸中心北塔 106、107 层餐厅 Windows on the World 的 25 年历史。

影片从 1970 年代餐厅开业讲起，记录其在股市周期中的起落、1993 年世贸中心爆炸案后的恢复，以及 2001 年原定举行的 25 周年庆典。餐厅当时有 400 多名员工，来自 20 多个国家，使用约 60 种语言；片中多位厨师、侍者和管理者讲述各自经历。

在 9·11 恐怖袭击中，Windows on the World 的 79 名员工和 91 名顾客遇难。影片此前于 8 月 28 日至 9 月 3 日在纽约限量上映，目前可通过 CNN 网站和应用观看。
title_en: CNN Premieres 'Top of the World' Documentary on the Iconic World Trade Center Restaurant
content_en:
*Top of the World*, a 40-minute documentary short, premiered on CNN on September 8. Directed by Betsy West and Julie Cohen (the filmmakers behind *RBG* and *Julia*), the film is adapted from Tom Roston's non-fiction book and chronicles the 25-year history of Windows on the World, the legendary restaurant that once occupied the 106th and 107th floors of the World Trade Center's North Tower.

The documentary traces the restaurant's journey from its opening in the 1970s through stock market fluctuations, its recovery after the 1993 World Trade Center bombing, and its planned 25th-anniversary celebration in 2001. At its peak, the restaurant employed over 400 staff members from more than 20 countries, speaking around 60 languages. The film features personal accounts from former chefs, servers, and managers.

Tragically, 79 employees and 91 guests at Windows on the World lost their lives during the September 11 terrorist attacks. Following a limited theatrical run in New York from August 28 to September 3, the documentary is now available to stream on CNN's website and app.
